Hombale Films Announces Global Release of 'Hanuman Ansh' on September 11

Indian production house Hombale Films announced that its film "Hanuman Ansh" will be released worldwide on September 11. The announcement follows the film's domestic box‑office earnings of about ₹61 crore. Business Today and Outlook India reported the upcoming worldwide rollout. No details about distribution partners or language versions were provided. The global release is scheduled after the film's domestic commercial success.
